name: The Feisty Princess' Royal Favor
overview: Renowned “ghost doctor” Su Jiaoyang is forced into a substitute marriage with the rumored ugly and disabled Prince Pei Shenzhi. But when he lifts her bridal veil, she is stunned to discover he is an old acquaintance with a long memory—and deeper grudges. What begins as a clash of sharp tongues and wounded pride slowly turns into reluctant affection.
